items: Two pitches per side: steep below the break, shallow above it. break is the fraction of h where the slope changes.
The barn roof: a mansard with a ridge instead of a flat top. Ridge along w.
Two slabs falling inward to a central valley; h is the valley depth below the eaves.
North-light shed roofs in a row; the bays run along w.
Four hips meeting at a point — a tower cap or a square pavilion.
A cone of base radius r + over: the cap of a round tower or a silo.
A bulbous dome of radius r and bulb height h, with a needle spire above it.
Jerkinhead: clip 0 is a plain gable, clip 1 is a full hip, in between the gable end is clipped.
A barrel vault whose axis runs along w; h is the rise at the crown.
A flat deck with a glazed strip inset in its top face, running along w.
